title: Clear an old stopped run from Needs you
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: a stopped run stays in Needs you until a newer engine run exists for the slice (#92). The S21 run stopped 9h ago stays with no way to dismiss it. Open owner question before building: dismiss command or key, whether it is recorded, and whether it deletes the run record (retention keeps 100 finished runs, state.runs-retention).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Seen 2026-10-20: a stopped run stays in Needs you until a newer engine run exists for the slice (#92). The S21 run stopped 9h ago stays with no way to dismiss it. Open owner question before building: dismiss command or key, whether it is recorded, and whether it deletes the run record (retention keeps 100 finished runs, state.runs-retention).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Per decision 117, run.dismiss on a stopped run sets dismissed_at. The run leaves the snapshot's engine_runs and ork status, and the project's needs-you count drops (new TestDismissedStoppedRunLeavesNeedsYou in internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go).
- The run record stays on disk: it still opens, DismissedAt is set, and dismissal deletes nothing (Prune is unchanged).
- run.dismiss refuses a run that is not stopped (paused, implement) with an error, refuses a busy run, and refuses an unknown run with not_found (CodeNotFound).
- ork dismiss RUN calls run.dismiss and prints the record (new cli test; see cli_test.go for the pattern).
- The TUI shows no row for a dismissed run (the snapshot lacks it; a test with a snapshot that has no run).
- docs/state.md says an older ork refuses run.json with dismissed_at (strict keys, state.go:130 Store.Open).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests first: internal/runrec (new TestDismissedAtRoundTrips and TestDismissRefusesUnstoppedRuns), internal/daemon (TestRunDismissRules in runs_test.go; TestDismissedStoppedRunLeavesNeedsYou in engine_runs_test.go), internal/cli (a dismiss call test). Run them and watch each fail.
2. internal/runrec/record.go: add DismissedAt time.Time `json:"dismissed_at,omitzero"` to Record after Commit (:188). Version stays 1, as S45 did (docs/state.md:144-146).
3. internal/runrec/store.go: add ErrNotStopped and func (r *Run) Dismiss() error next to Update (:233). It sets DismissedAt from r.store.now() when State is stopped, is a no-op when already set, and returns ErrNotStopped otherwise.
4. internal/engine/engine.go:198: add func (e *Engine) Dismiss() error { return e.run.Dismiss() }, next to Snapshot. Use the managed handle. A second Store.Open handle would overwrite dismissed_at on its next save, because save (store.go:261) writes that handle's whole record.
5. internal/daemon/runs.go const block (:24-29): MethodRunDismiss = "run.dismiss". internal/daemon/handlers.go:76: add it to the run case list.
6. runs.go handleRun (:400-416): route dismiss to a new d.dismissRun(p). Under d.runs.mu: a managed run that is busy is refused; a managed run calls r.engine.Dismiss(); otherwise store.Open(p.Run) then Dismiss(). Unknown runs return CodeNotFound, as ownerRun does (:323).
7. runs.go engineRuns (:417-461): skip a run whose DismissedAt is set, after the project check.
8. internal/cli/cli.go:167 add "dismiss" to the case list; ownerCommand (cli/run.go:164-190) already sends "run."+command, so no new client code. Add "ork dismiss RUN" to usageText (cli.go:40-50).
9. Docs: docs/state.md:122-125 (the state list) gets dismissed_at; docs/dashboard.md:44-45 says a stopped run stops counting when dismissed too; docs/design.md:542-543 (CLI list) gets ork dismiss RUN.
10. Mutation-check: drop the engineRuns skip (step 7) and confirm TestDismissedStoppedRunLeavesNeedsYou goes red.
Note: if S32 (EngineRun.Section) lands first, do the filter there instead of step 7, so ork status, the Overview and the daemon count read one place.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/runrec ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./... before the report
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
- adj lint
- Run by name: TestDismissedAtRoundTrips, TestDismissRefusesUnstoppedRuns, TestRunDismissRules, TestDismissedStoppedRunLeavesNeedsYou, TestRetentionKeepsDismissedRuns (Prune in store.go:182 still counts it as finished).
- Check the strict-key note: a run.json with dismissed_at must open with the new code and must fail the pre-change Store.Open (write it by hand in a test temp dir).
